cases.rationale: The selected ready Change has clear behavior, cause, ownership, edit path, authority, and decisive verification; neither diagnosis nor risk-qualified TDD applies.
The reproducible multi-layer failure remains unexplained, so diagnosis takes precedence and guessed production mutation is not permitted.
The persisted public state transition is a concrete changed risk for which a pre-mutation RED materially improves safety.
The request authorizes only a status explanation and grants no product mutation or delivery authority.
The unavailable release Discipline requires loading the manual fallback first, which then stops before versioned mutation because identity is unconfirmed and the exact candidate is unclean.
Recovery must stop before reopening because multiple archives require exact selection and no lifecycle mutation authority exists.
A progress inquiry is an update rather than an interruption; Manage reports current evidence and then continues the authorized work.
The explicit pause requires active workers to be stopped while preserving focus, with no further mutation until resume.
